transfer_limits: Tiberian accent conditions are not automatically conditions in Babylonian bowl transmission.
Molin proposed pausal/contextual readings can be represented as separate candidate forms, but the bowl context needs independently supported native prosodic evidence.
Written waw pattern alone does not establish anI boundary or license a Tiberian vowel/stress operation.
Do not infer inherited sound change/contact/acoustics from accent mismatch; no ancient Hz/duration recovered.
Do not read table10 IPA as clean original glyph data: this extraction contains damaged ordering.
